g.text: Independent SPI DL/DR; shared STIM timing

g.desc: Independent SPI DL/DR; shared STIM timing

g.text: COMBINED FPGA + LT3046 LDO | V6 | 4 x 1k ASIC BOARDS

g.desc: COMBINED FPGA + LT3046 LDO | V6 | 4 x 1k ASIC BOARDS

g.text: 116 DIRECT FPGA DIGITAL FUNCTIONS | 88 INDEPENDENT RECORDING RETURNS

g.desc: 116 DIRECT FPGA DIGITAL FUNCTIONS | 88 INDEPENDENT RECORDING RETURNS

g.text: No J1/J2 interboard plugs or receptacles remain. Carrier DF40 80-contact plugs J101 / J201 / J301 / J401 are retained.

g.desc: No J1/J2 interboard plugs or receptacles remain. Carrier DF40 80-contact plugs J101 / J201 / J301 / J401 are retained.

g.text: Named ASIC data, clock, read, sync, SPI and shared controls connect the FPGA at left to the carrier plugs below.

g.desc: Named ASIC data, clock, read, sync, SPI and shared controls connect the FPGA at left to the carrier plugs below.

g.text: ANNOTATION GUIDE: electrical connections use matching net labels; lines above are system context.

g.desc: ANNOTATION GUIDE: electrical connections use matching net labels; lines above are system context.

g.text: Direct digital nets replace the FPGA-to-LDO mezzanine link. ASIC and FPGA input rails remain separate. Placement, routing, heat and stack fit are unqualified.

g.desc: Direct digital nets replace the FPGA-to-LDO mezzanine link. ASIC and FPGA input rails remain separate. Placement, routing, heat and stack fit are unqualified.

g.text: The FPGA at left connects directly

g.desc: The FPGA at left connects directly

g.text: The chip boxes show external boards;

g.desc: The chip boxes show external boards;

g.text: all LDO components are drawn below.

g.desc: all LDO components are drawn below.

g.text: Signed voltage, load and sequence: TBD.

g.desc: Signed voltage, load and sequence: TBD.

g.text: Nominal rail settings are reference intentions; load, supply, return, physical stack and manufacturing qualification remain open.

g.desc: Nominal rail settings are reference intentions; load, supply, return, physical stack and manufacturing qualification remain open.

g.text: V6: direct FPGA + LDO union; four 60-contact interboard connectors removed. All 116 digital functions and four 1k carrier interfaces retained.

g.desc: V6: direct FPGA + LDO union; four 60-contact interboard connectors removed. All 116 digital functions and four 1k carrier interfaces retained.

g.text: Four 1k boards still need a qualified

g.desc: Four 1k boards still need a qualified

g.text: V6 PCB is an unrouted placement study.

g.desc: V6 PCB is an unrouted placement study.
